Mali.summary: Following a decision by the Guinean authorities banning traditional and illegal gold panning on their soil, Mali is facing an influx of migrants on an unprecedented scale. Nearly 80,000 people, mostly foreign nationals representing at least six nationalities, have crossed the border at Kourémalé since 2 November Faced with this critical situation that suddenly occurred, the Malian State immediately reacted under the aegis of the Prime Minister, Chairman of the Interministerial Committee for Crisis and Disaster Management .

Niger.title: Niger: Niger Receives 1.65m Liters of Algerian Fuel As Shortages Persist
Niger.summary: Niger has received its first shipment of fuel from Algeria, with 53 tanker trucks delivering 1.65 million liters of petroleum products to the northern city of Agadez as the country seeks to ease fuel shortages and strengthen energy cooperation with its northern neighbor. The convoy arrived on October 31, 2026, under military escort from both countries, according to Niger's state broadcaster RTN.
